why_hero_subtitle: Mwangosanthula chitikiti cha 'Bitcoin Imalandiridwa Pano'. Apa ndi chifukwa chake izi ndi nkhani yabwino — kwa bizinesi iyi, ndi kwa inu.
why_intro_c1: Bizinesi yomwe muli nayoyi imalandira Bitcoin — netiweki ya malipiro yamakono, yotseguka yomwe aliyense angagwiritse ntchito, kulikonse padziko lapansi, popanda mabanki kapena apakati otenga gawo.
why_intro_c2: Pansipa pali baibulo lalifupi la chifukwa chake kulandira Bitcoin ndi kwabwino kwa bizinesi iyi, ndi chifukwa chake kugwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin ndi kwabwino kwa inu monga kasitomala.
why_for_business: Chifukwa chake Bitcoin ndi yabwino kwa bizinesi iyi
why_for_business_intro: Kulandira Bitcoin kumalola bizinesi kusunga zambiri za kugulitsa kulikonse, kulipidwa pomwepo popanda ma chargeback, ndi kufikira ogwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin padziko lonse — zonse popanda mapangano kapena ndalama za mwezi.
why_biz_s1_c1: Malipiro a Bitcoin amapeweka mabanki ndi makampani a makhadi omwe amatenga 2–3% pa kugulitsa kulikonse. Bizinesi imasunga zambiri za zomwe mukulipira — zomwe nthawi zambiri zikutanthauza mitengo yabwino ndi ntchito yabwino kwa inu.
why_biz_s2_c1: Malipiro a Bitcoin amatsiriza mu masekondi, mwachindunji kuchokera mu chikwama chanu kupita ku bizinesi. Palibe kudikira masiku banki kuti ipereke ndalama, ndipo palibe mikangano yokwera mtengo ya chargeback — kotero bizinesi ikhoza kuyang'anira kupereka ntchito kwa makasitomala m'malo molimbana ndi chinyengo.
why_biz_s3_c1: Palibe mapangano, ndalama za mwezi, kapena ndalama zoyikira kuti bizinesi ilandire Bitcoin. Ndipo mamiliyoni a ogwiritsa ntchito Bitcoin padziko lonse amafufuza amalonda omwe amalandira — zomwe zimapereka bizinesi iyi mwayi waulere wa makasitomala atsopano.
why_business_cta_intro: Mukuyendetsa bizinesi ndipo mukufuna kuyamba kulandira Bitcoin?
why_good_for_you: Chifukwa chake Bitcoin ndi yabwino kwa inunso
why_good_for_you_intro: Bitcoin sili yothandiza chabe pa kasha — ndi mtundu wabwino wa ndalama yomwe imateteza zomwe mwasunga, chinsinsi chanu, ndi ufulu wanu wochita malonda. Apa pali baibulo lalifupi.
why_s1_c1: Kukwera kwa mitengo kumachitika ndalama zambiri zikamasindikizidwa kapena kupangidwa kuchokera ku zopanda kanthu. Izi zimapangitsa kuti ndalama zomwe muli nazo zikhale ndi mtengo wochepa pakapita nthawi — ndipo ndi chifukwa chake mitengo imapitiriza kukwera chaka ndi chaka.
why_s1_c2: Bitcoin ili ndi kuchuluka kokhazikika kwa ma coin 21 miliyoni. Palibe boma, banki, kapena kampani yomwe ingasindikize zambiri. Zomwe mwasunga m'Bitcoin zimasunga mtengo wake pakapita nthawi m'malo motaya mtengo modekha.
why_s2: Bitcoin ilibe kuthawa kwa anthu kumabanki
why_s2_c1: Mabanki angapo a U.S. agwa m'zaka zaposachedwa chifukwa cha kuthawira ku banki. Pamene makasitomala ambiri ayesa kuchotsa nthawi imodzi, mabanki sanali ndi ndalama zokwanira kuwabwezera anthu onse.
why_s2_c2: M'malo mosunga ndalama zanu basi, mabanki amakongoza ndi kuyika ndalama zambiri. Ngati ma investment amenewo achitidwa zoyipa — kapena ngati osungira ndalama achotsa chikhulupiriro — banki ikhoza kulephera, ndipo ndalama zomwe mwayika zikhoza kutsekedwa kapena kutayika.
why_s2_c3: Ndi Bitcoin, mukhoza kusunga ndalama zanu mwachindunji mu chikwama chanu. Palibe banki. Palibe wapakatikati. Palibe kuthawira ku banki.
why_s3_c1: Mosiyana ndi makhadi ongongoletsa, PayPal, kapena akaunti za mabanki, Bitcoin saifuna chilolezo cha aliyense kuti igwiritsidwe ntchito.
why_s3_c2: Palibe amene angatseke akaunti yanu, kuletsa malipiro, kapena kukulekanitsani ndi netiweki. Ndi dongosolo loyamba lazachuma m'mbiri lomwe mungagwiritse ntchito mwaufulu, popanda mantha a kuletsedwa kapena kulanda.
why_s4_c1: Bitcoin nthawi zambiri samvetsedwa, koma ikuchita zabwino zambiri padziko mwa kakhalidwe.
why_s4_c2: Yathandiza atsogoleri a ufulu wa anthu kumenyera ufulu, kuchepetsa methane wa padziko lonse kuchokera ku malo otaya zinyalala ndi minda yamafuta, kukhazikitsa magridi a magetsi, ndi kupereka ndalama ku zinthu za anthu monga mapaki adziko.
why_whats_next_intro: Ngati ndi nthawi yoyamba mukusanthula chitikiti cha Bitcoin, apa pali malo othandiza kupita kuchokera apa.
